plugins.name: design
plugins.description: Design system funnel — 7 skills. Verb 0 detail (read-only, no artifact) explains the map of the funnel and routes a stated intent to one of six stack-agnostic case classes, extended by the platform workflow of the matching sc-* pivot when installed. The 5-verb pipeline define · destructure · adjust (freeze the 4-artifact contract rooted by release.json, migrate 1.x) · enforce (portable linter derived from the contract + sc-* pivot + 4 vocabulary gates: tokens.css import, generation rules, plan success_condition, pre-commit) · diffuse (elements under gate + sc-* pivot), plus harness (standalone mockup scaffold, outside the funnel). A 5th gate of a different nature measures rendering fidelity against the resolved mockup. Every contract carries a computed maturity status (extracted · normalized · validated · production-ready) that gates conformity: run-gates.py exits 4 below the threshold and every known gap caps the status instead of being recorded as prose; contrast is computed per theme at freeze and declarative interactive states are checked without markup. Adds copycat (per-page mockup→contract reconciliation agent + Python fidelity oracle: machine CLOSED/OPEN verdict, structural completeness scan, coverage guard, deviation-ledger with id + registry validation, ledger-unused detection, active-frame isolation, check_text per-target, collections LCS-diff, collection-level ack, visual-diff companion). Adds config-gen.py (contract → oracle config) and migrate-contract.py (1.x → 2.0). Platform-level workflows live in the sc-* pivots under a skeleton frozen by the pivot contract. BREAKING 2.0.0: the monolithic contract is split into components.json, policies.json, oracle.json and release.json; the linter reads the new format only and exits 3 on a 1.x contract.
